beats.say: One evening created a number one you know by heart.
September 1981, Mountain Studios in Montreux, Switzerland.
Queen invited David Bowie down to the studio, and it took off from there.
Bowie sang backing vocals for Queen's song Cool Cat.
Afterwards they worked together and wrote Under Pressure, credited to all five musicians.
One marathon evening session recorded the track.
Bowie took over the song lyrically, and he and Freddie Mercury had a fierce battle over the mix.
Released in October 1981, it reached number one on the UK Singles Chart.
Which Queen song do you sing loudest?

facts: Under Pressure is a song by Queen and David Bowie.
It was released as a single in October 1981.
It was recorded at Mountain Studios in Montreux, Switzerland, in September 1981.
Queen invited David Bowie down to the studio and it took off from there.
The track was recorded during one marathon evening session.
David Bowie sang backing vocals for Queen's song Cool Cat.
Afterwards they worked together and wrote Under Pressure.
The song was credited as co-written by the five musicians.
David Bowie took over the song lyrically.
Freddie Mercury and David Bowie had a fierce battle over the mix.
The song reached number one on the UK Singles Chart.
